data.title: Generalize graph layout engine + add NormalTree mode
data.description:
Parent verify issue tracking the two-step generalization of the issue graph layout engine into a generic, IGraphNode-driven engine that emits semantic edges and an occupancy matrix.

Tracked via OpenSpec changes:
- generalize-graph-layout-engine: extract the engine, ship LayoutMode.IssueGraph, migrate list --tree and list --next, retire BuildTaskGraphLayout / BuildFilteredTaskGraphLayout / TaskGraph / TaskGraphNode.
- add-normal-tree-layout-mode: implement LayoutMode.NormalTree (parent-first, depth-from-root), add EdgeAttachSide metadata, ship a test-only ASCII renderer for NormalTree.

See openspec/changes/generalize-graph-layout-engine/ and openspec/changes/add-normal-tree-layout-mode/ for full proposals, designs, specs, and task breakdowns. Validate with: openspec validate <change> --strict.
